chunks.en: primitive communalism, or unordial communalism. But then once human society gets a little bigger, we immediately develop classes. And Mark said there are five historical processes. The first one, primitive communalism. The next one, slavery. The world was divided into two groups of people, the slave owners and the slave. That happened, and for a while that was the way the whole world was organized. Slave owners and slaves, according to Mark's.
chunks.zh: 原始公社制，或者说无阶级公社制。但一旦人类社会稍微发展大一些，我们立刻就产生了阶级。马克说有五个历史过程。第一个是原始公社制。下一个是奴隶制。世界被分成两类人——奴隶主和奴隶。这种情况发生了，并且在一段时间内，整个世界就是这样组织的。根据马克的说法，是奴隶主和奴隶。

chunks.en: And then there was a revolution and it changed to feudalism. Fuedalism is two classes of people. The land-owning class, the aristocrats, the kings, and all that, and the peasants, the serfs, the people who are supposed to be estates of the rich. So we have two classes of people, the aristocrats, the kings, the monads, and the serfs and the peasants. Again, two classes of people. Then there was a revolution in 1874. There was a French Revolution.
chunks.zh: 然后发生了一场革命，它改变为封建制度。封建制度有两类人。拥有土地的阶级，即贵族、国王等等，以及农民、农奴，就是那些被认为是富人产业的人。所以我们有两类人，贵族、国王、蒙纳德，以及农奴和农民。再一次，两类人。然后在1874年发生了一场革命。那是法国大革命。

chunks.en: There was a British Revolution in the West. And then in 1871 and so on and so on, we will gradually say we went to the age that you live in, the age of capitalism. You live in the age of capitalism. There are two classes of people again, right? The joisi class, the capital-owning class, and the working class, the class that works for our wages. All of you will be proletariat when you live to all of you. Most of you will be proletariat, the working class,
chunks.zh: 在西方发生了英国革命。然后在1871年，等等，我们会逐渐说我们进入了你所生活的时代，资本主义时代。你们生活在资本主义时代。又有两类人，对吧？资产阶级，拥有资本的阶级，以及工人阶级，为我们工资工作的阶级。当你们成长起来时，你们大多数人都会成为无产阶级。你们大多数人都会成为无产阶级，工人阶级。

chunks.en: people who work for our wage. But then there's another class of people, the joisi. Just Google how much half of this people. And then there will be the next revolution that's supposed to happen. We live in late-state capitalism. And we'll go to socialism. Socialism is actually still two classes of people, the state managerial class and the only when you reach communism. So arguments in the communist class. Once you reach communism, there will be no class again.
chunks.zh: 为我们工资而工作的人。但随后还有另一类人，叫做‘乔伊西’。只要谷歌一下这些人一半的收入是多少。接下来就会发生所谓的下一场革命。我们生活在晚期资本主义社会中。我们将会进入社会主义。社会主义实际上仍然有两类人，即国家管理阶层，只有当你达到共产主义时，才会在共产主义阶层中消失。一旦达到共产主义，就不会再有阶级了。

chunks.en: That's why, in a sense, communism does not believe in religion. Communism argued that there is no need for religion. Because religion is a relic of the class struggle. But it's simply, and I will read this first. Religious suffering is, at one and at the same time, expression of real suffering and a protest against real suffering. Religion is the side of the oppression. It's wonderful. Religious suffering is, if there's anything
chunks.zh: 这就是为什么，从某种意义上说，共产主义不相信宗教。共产主义认为没有宗教的必要。因为宗教是阶级斗争的遗物。但很简单，我将先读这一段。宗教的痛苦，同时是现实痛苦的表现，也是对现实痛苦的抗议。宗教是压迫的一面。这非常精彩。宗教的痛苦，如果有的话

chunks.en: you want to memorize about religion, memorize this. Not the first part. Religious suffering is, at one and at the same time, the expression of real suffering. You really do suffer. But it's also a protest against suffering. If you are a serve or you then you are politically powerless, you don't own anything. And you are economically deprived. You have no money. You have no property. You have nothing. And you're constantly under the control of the aristocrat.
chunks.zh: 你想记住关于宗教的内容，就记住这个。不是前面那部分。宗教的痛苦，同时也是现实痛苦的一种表现。你真的在受苦。但它也是对痛苦的一种抗议。如果你是一个仆人或者你是奴隶，那么你在政治上是无权的，你什么也不拥有。而且你在经济上是贫困的。你没有钱，你没有财产，你一无所有。你不断处在贵族的控制之下。

chunks.en: So religion, and this is the phrase that it's in the book, religion is the side of the oppressed, the heart of a heartless world. And the soul of a soulless condition. It is the opium of it. And that's argue that in the end, you have to get rid of religion. Because the abolition of religion as an illusory happiness of the people is the demand for real happiness. The demand to give up the illusion about its condition is the demand to give up a condition that needs illus.
chunks.zh: 所以宗教，这也是书中使用的短语，宗教是被压迫者的一面，是无情世界的心脏，是没有灵魂状况的灵魂。它是它的鸦片。并且论证说，最终，你必须摆脱宗教。因为取消宗教作为人民虚幻的幸福，是对真正幸福的要求。要求放弃对自身状况的幻想，就是要求放弃需要幻想的状况。

chunks.en: So wonderful phrase. Religion is the side of the oppressed picture, the heart of a heartless world. And the soul of a soulless condition. So for Marx, put it simply, religion is an imbued. Religion was created by the class to make the non-only class happy, tied to oppressed people of people. Who is oppressed, the workers are oppressed. Who is oppressed, the peasants are oppressed. Who is oppressed, the slaves are oppressed. And you live in oppression.
chunks.zh: 如此美妙的短语。宗教是被压迫者画面的一部分，是无情世界的心，是无魂状态的灵魂。因此，对于马克思来说，简单地说，宗教是一种灌输。宗教是由阶级创造的，使非特定阶级的人快乐，和被压迫的人联系在一起。谁是被压迫的，工人被压迫。谁是被压迫的，农民被压迫。谁是被压迫的，奴隶被压迫。而你生活在压迫中。

chunks.en: How do you accept your oppression? Illusion of Marx argued that man makes religion. Religion does not make man. State the society together, the people who control. Whether it's a non-only class, or a capital-only class, or a slave-only class, they create religion. Why? Because religion is used. Religion is useful because it provides an area of the world, provides a moral sanction, and it provides the key word in consolation. Very interesting word that Karl Marx used
chunks.zh: 你如何接受你的压迫？马克思认为的错觉是人创造宗教。宗教并不创造人。国家联合了社会，由人来控制。无论是非专有阶级，还是资本专有阶级，或是奴隶专有阶级，他们都会创造宗教。为什么？因为宗教是有用的。宗教之所以有用，是因为它提供了世界的一个领域，提供道德上的认可，并提供慰藉中的关键词。这是卡尔·马克思使用的一个非常有趣的词。

chunks.en: by their interest, the spiritual aroma of religion. Who knows that Marx actually writes beautifully, the aroma of religion. And it's a mess. So spiritual aroma is, have you ever sat in a room where someone is smoking okia? Anyone? Well, my uncles smoked okia. So I used to visit him all the time. And you sit in a room with him when he's smoking his okia pipe in the room. Smell of this wonderful, very, very sweet. The wonderful smells, if they're never smelled,
chunks.zh: 他们的兴趣，宗教的精神气息。谁知道马克思实际上写得很美，宗教的气息。而且这是一团糟。所以精神气息就是，你有没有坐在一个有人在抽okia的房间里？有人吗？嗯，我的叔叔抽okia。所以我以前经常去看他。当你和他坐在房间里，他抽着他的okia烟斗。闻到这种美妙的，非常，非常甜的味道。如果这些美妙的气味从未闻过，

chunks.en: is there somewhere to get the smell from? Before I try, how do I smell the smell of okia? You should. I have smelled it, practically, every day. It's a wonderful sweet smell. And so Karl Marx says, this is the spiritual aroma of religion. It is an okia, you are addicted to it. And when you're addicted to it, it gives you a sense of satisfaction. This sense of satisfaction is not real, it's a sense. And so he calls it religion as the process of celestialization.
chunks.zh: 有没有地方能闻到这个气味？在我尝试之前，我该如何闻到okia的气味？你应该闻。我几乎每天都闻到它。这是一种美妙的甜美气味。正如卡尔·马克思所说，这是宗教的精神香气。它是okia，你会对它上瘾。当你上瘾时，它会给你一种满足感。这种满足感不是真实的，它只是一种感觉。因此，他称之为宗教，即升华的过程。

chunks.en: Celestialization is a process of making something, something, a spiritual quality. So religion is a process of making something divine of the celestial nature, so that this celestial thing takes you with the meaning system that is necessary. Control religion then becomes part of a cluster.
chunks.zh: 天化是将某物赋予某种精神特质的过程。所以宗教是将某物赋予神圣的天界本质的过程，这样这种天界的事物就会通过必要的意义体系引导你。控制宗教于是成为一个集群的一部分。
